newsitems.title: VOID Interactive зарегистрировала торговую марку для сюжетного спин-оффа Ready or Not
newsitems.contents:
Студия VOID Interactive, известная по тактическому шутеру Ready or Not, зарегистрировала новую торговую марку, которая может указывать на разработку сюжетного ответвления серии. 28 сентября 2026 года в европейском ведомстве EUIPO появилась заявка на название Warrants: A Ready or Not Story.

Само название прямо намекает на отдельную игру с упором на историю, однако официально проект пока не анонсирован. Торговая марка охватывает сразу несколько категорий товаров и услуг, включая видеоигры, одежду, печатную продукцию, развлечения и программное обеспечение.

Особенно примечательно то, что заявка практически полностью совпадает с регистрацией оригинальной Ready or Not. Это позволяет предположить, что речь действительно идёт о новом проекте во вселенной игры, а не просто о товарном знаке для сопутствующей продукции.

Сама Ready or Not не является сюжетной игрой в привычном понимании. В ней есть связанные между собой задания и общий лор, однако полноценной сюжетной кампании с развитием персонажей и постановочными сценами у проекта нет. Warrants: A Ready or Not Story может стать попыткой VOID Interactive расширить вселенную и сделать ставку именно на повествование.

Косвенно на это указывают и вакансии студии. В текущем списке позиций VOID Interactive есть должность Associate Cinematic Animator. В описании работы упоминаются создание анимаций для внутриигровых сцен, кинематографических эпизодов и постановочных сюжетных последовательностей, а также работа над персонажами, способными усиливать эмоциональное воздействие повествования.

Пока неизвестно, насколько далеко продвинулась разработка Warrants: A Ready or Not Story и будет ли это полноценный сюжетный спин-офф или проект другого формата. VOID Interactive официально игру пока не представляла, поэтому подробностей о геймплее, платформах и сроках выхода нет.

Если проект действительно находится в разработке, он может заметно расширить формулу Ready or Not за пределы тактического шутера. Однако пока существование игры подтверждает только зарегистрированная торговая марка, а окончательные планы VOID Interactive могут измениться.

[p][/p][h1][b]Welcome back, Officers.[/b][/h1][p]
We hope you’ve been well. 

The Mission Editor has been available for just over a week and we’ve been thoroughly impressed with your creations. Ranging from realistic to the absurd, it’s clear to us that you’re having as much fun (maybe more) as we hoped you would.  
 
 In today’s Community Exhibit we’ll be highlighting all the art, mods, and content you’ve been making. In addition, we’ll be also be highlighting some of the Missions you’ve been sharing so that the rest of the community can experience them as well.[/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][h1][b][i][u]

Stack Up supports US and Allied veterans by promoting positive mental health and combating veteran suicide through gaming and geek culture.

[h1]Attention Officers,[/h1][p align="start"]In the v1.5 Update for RoN we are releasing the Mission Editor, a new feature allowing granular tweaking of gameplay variables within an existing mission, with a particular focus on customizing non-playable characters.[/p][p align="start"]This is our initial introductory launch for the Mission Editor feature; be on the lookout for improvements to Mission Editor in the future, along with more bug fixes and content for the game.[/p][p align="start"][b]Free New Styles of the Triple Weapon Pack Weapons, Released to All Players:[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Ready or Not Triple Weapon Pack weapons, which were initially added with RoN’s console release, are now being released for free as three new cosmetic styles to all players regardless of platform or game edition. These new free styles are the MK-V 'HC' (Hard Chrome) pistol, 590M 'FDE' (Flat Dark Earth) shotgun, and M32A1 'LSPD' Blue rotary grenade launcher.[/p][p align="start"]Players who were already eligible for the triple weapon pack weapons previously (i.e. PC platform players, console pre-order owners, or console Triple Weapon Pack owners) will now have access to both the original style and the new style of each of these weapons.[/p][p align="start"][i]We are continuously monitoring your bug reports. Please report any bugs you find in our official Ready or Not Discord, using the bug report channels! There they can be structured and collected in one place so we can most effectively deal with them: [/i][url="https://discord.com/channels/310075021882294272/1050535723087958156"]Ready or Not Bug Reports[/url]  [/p][p align="start"][i]Please check our official Discord for an updated list of some known issues in the  [url="https://discord.com/channels/310075021882294272/963832413820174426"]#known-issues-and-fixes channel[/url].[/i]  [/p][h3][b]Update Day General FAQ:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Q: ‘My game mods broke on PC with this update, why did that happen?’[/p][p]> A: When Ready or Not or games in general release updates to the game, the files for the game in areas related to new game content or fixes then changes. If mods were using the old files to function that have since changed to new files, those mods will likely need to update in order to work properly with the new version of the game’s files.[/p][p][b]Ready or Not Modding Update Tips: [/b][url="https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/"]https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Q: ‘Why does an update download initially seem frustratingly large in data/gigabytes, even when the game doesn’t actually take up that much more storage when the download finishes’[/p][p]> A: Game service platforms such as Steam etc. may update games by overwriting the game's files with the new files to replace it. For example, this means a update download that initially shows as 6GB during the download may actually only expand the game by 1GB in size, since it is largely just overwriting old game files for the other 5GB of data.[/p][/*][*][p]Q: ‘Why does an update take so long to download despite my fast internet’[/p][p]> A: Other routine checks that a game service platform does to confirm game file integrity on the local storage device (e.g. your hard drive such as a HDD or SSD) during an update download can extend the perceived download size/time.[/p][/*][*][p]Q: ‘Why didn’t my game update yet on my console platform?'[/p][p]> A: Console platforms do not necessarily support auto-updates, so you may have to trigger the update manually within your game library with an internet connection.

[h1]Welcome back, Officers.[/h1][p]
It's been an exciting time for all of us at VOID Interactive. While you've been producing amazing community content, we're also busy building the future of Ready or Not. Let's get into it.

[/p][h2][b][i][u]Mission Editor[/u][/i][/b][/h2][p]
As some of you may have seen, we recently announced that we're working on a new feature, the Mission Editor, and that it'll be releasing in the coming weeks.

The Mission Editor will afford you increased replayability and unique gameplay situations through its deep modifier suite for AI characters and gameplay variables.

From swapping appearance of suspects of one level with another, giving all suspects knives or M249s, tweaking the behavior of civilians, to giving yourself only 50hp, there are countless new ways to engage with missions with this feature.

Get ready to create, save, and share edited missions with your squad mates and the community when the free update arrives in the coming weeks. We can't wait to include some of your Mission Editor creations in these Community Exhibits!

Internally, we've had a ton of fun with this feature already. We can't wait to see how it changes the way you play Ready or Not when it drops.

You can check out the detailed Development Briefing [b][url="https://voidinteractive.net/vol-90-ready-or-not-development-briefing/"]HERE[/url][/b].

newsitems.author: catindabox
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Attention Officers, [/h1][p align="justify"]Welcome to the 90th edition of our Ready or Not Development Briefing, Thursday July 30th, 2026. [/p][p align="justify"]In this briefing we are introducing the Mission Editor, a new feature allowing granular tweaking of gameplay variables within an existing mission, with a particular focus on customizing non-playable characters.  [/p][p align="justify"]The Mission Editor will be releasing for free along with bug fixes to all platforms in the coming weeks as part of the v1.5/1.5.1 Update for Ready or Not. [/p][p align="justify"]This is our initial introduction launch for the Mission Editor feature; be on the lookout for improvements to Mission Editor in the future, along with more bug fixes and content for the game. [/p][p][i]Note: These development briefings serve to keep you in the loop about parts of our ongoing support for Ready or Not. However, the briefings do not encompass everything that we’re working on at a given moment. Please keep in mind that the content in our development briefings may still be a work in progress and subject to change.[/i] [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]Mission Editor[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]The Mission Editor is a precise modification tool that allows you to custom tailor Suspect, Civilian, SWAT AI, and player along with some other gameplay related variables for a given mission. This feature is arriving in the coming weeks to all platforms in the free v1.5/1.5.1 update for Ready or Not. [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]Suspect AI Modifiers[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]Suspect AI modifiers make up the brunt of the content in Mission Editor. These modifiers allow you to fine tune behaviors and combat effectiveness of suspects. Appearance presets from other missions can also be selected, including their associated voice-over sets. Note that mission-specific characters who are objectives, named, or otherwise required may remain. [/p][p align="justify"][i][u]\[Image below: Body of a paramilitary suspect spotted by the flashlight of a SWAT officer on Thank You, Come Again][/u][/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/b6423ee6100f629f33178a484d48f42008c995f2.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]For players that want more elusive encounters, suspects can be assigned the cowardly archetype so that they are more likely to hide behind or under objects in missions. If you want to go against a more coordinated threat, assign the ‘tactical’ archetype to suspects. [/p][p align="justify"]If multiple archetypes are included within a mission’s archetype pool, the mission will randomly use archetypes from that pool for eligible AI— subject to mission-specific rules and required characters. The same archetype pooling approach is present in Civilian AI customization too. [/p][p align="justify"][i][u]\[Image below: Suspect from the Carriers of the Vine mission surrendering on Buy Cheap, Buy Twice][/u][/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/451c0db144a49ed1e23a858828feeee5feb299bf.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]Choose the pool of primary weapons that your suspects are using from an M249 to a bolt action rifle, and which backup weapon they may have. If you’re comfortable maintaining a 21-foot distance, assign your suspects knives, bomb vests (the total number of which in a mission can be changed), irrational archetype, and no primary weapons. [/p][p align="justify"][u][i]\[Image below: Suspect from Sinuous Trail seen on the Leviathan mission with an M249 light machinegun and explosive vest][/i][/u]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/150cd7c0340a1e9c77a78ef3e01418a5102c943e.jpg"][/img]Perhaps you only want one suspect on 23 Megabytes A Second, you can do that too. Or on another level you might like a manhunt by setting maximum civilians, but just one suspect that is also using the cowardly archetype with a concealed weapon. [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]SWAT AI Modifiers[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]SWAT AI modifiers are geared toward modifying the combat effectiveness of your SWAT NPC officers, although containing less variables than Suspect AI. These modifiers include SWAT visual stimulus reaction time, Morale Damage by SWAT Activity, and Morale Damage by SWAT Activity Multiplier. Examples of SWAT activities that cause morale damage include compliance commands, less lethal weapons, kicking in doors, gunfire, and ordinance usage. [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]Civilian AI Modifiers[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]Civilians share a subset of the modifiers available for suspects, without the same emphasis on combat. These modifiers will let you change how compliant civilians are and adjust their civilian behavior archetypes.[/p][p align="justify"]For example, the prisoner archetype will result in civilians being pre-restrained upon entering a level. This can be used as a quality of life measure for players who want runs with less civilians to restrain, or to emulate hostage-type scenarios. [/p][h2][b][i][u]Player Modifiers[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]The amount of player health can be modified, as can the max number of bandages. With this setup, players can choose to enhance how hardcore a given mission is. With only 50hp, any shot that defeats armor could be immediately lethal to a player. With only one bandage, players only have one opportunity to stem a bleeding wound. [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]Miscellaneous Modifiers[/u][/i][/b] [/h2][p align="justify"]A select number of miscellaneous mission-related modifiers can be changed too, which affect how the mission presents itself or how much complexity is offered. [/p][p align="justify"]The length of bomb timers in a bomb threat mission, multi-selectable door trap types, enabling/disabling default character spawns, max locked doors percentage, max open door percentage, and chance of suspect suicide can be modified. [/p][p align="justify"]Being able to change the maximum amount of doors open can create an increased challenge due to suspects having increased sightlines throughout the level. This contrasts with the max locked doors, which generally can be a quality of life change since you won’t need to make as many forced entries. [/p][p align="justify"][/p][h2][u][i][b]Short Patch Preview[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p]A video containing a short preview of some of the fixes coming in v1.5/1.5.1 went up on our YouTube channel today. This video only contains a handful of the fixes that will be included in the full changelog:  [/p][previewyoutube="7oxRVhm70DY;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][h1]Conclusion [/h1][p align="justify"]The Mission Editor affords you increased replayability and unique gameplay situations through its deep modifier suite for AI characters and gameplay variables.  [/p][p align="justify"]From swapping appearance of suspects of one level with another, giving all suspects knives or M249s, tweaking the behavior of civilians, to giving yourself only 50hp, there are countless new ways to engage with missions with this feature. [/p][p align="justify"]Get ready to create, save, and share edited missions with your squad mates and the community in the v1.5 update for RoN, arriving in the coming weeks.  [/p][p align="justify"]Once again, this is our initial introduction launch for the Mission Editor feature; be on the lookout for improvements to Mission Editor in the future, along with more bug fixes and content for the game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90eea2aeb7449fef24bf55b66fe1bc4c923c6b69.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Follow Ready or Not on Steam[u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/"] here[/url][/u].[/b]

[h3][b]Welcome back, Officers.

[/b][/h3][p]It’s summer in the northern hemisphere, so many of us at VOID are trying to stay cool. We hope you can do the same.

While we’re hard at work on what’s next for Ready or Not, we’ve got another community exhibit for you to highlight what’s going on in, and around, the RoN community.



﻿[/p][h1][u][i][b]Stack Up Partnership[/b][/i][/u][/h1][p]
We’re thrilled to announce that we’re working with a new charity partner, Stack Up.

Stack Up supports US and Allied veterans by promoting positive mental health and combating veteran suicide through gaming and geek culture with four pillar programs:
[/p][h3][u][b]Supply Crates[/b][/u][/h3][p]Video game care packages full of the latest games, gear, and consoles sent to deployed units and veterans in need.
[/p][h3][u][b]Air Assaults[/b][/u][/h3][p]All-expenses-paid trips to bring deserving veterans to gaming and geek culture events.
[/p][h3][u][b]The Stacks[/b][/u][/h3][p]Volunteer teams engaged in veteran outreach and community betterment projects in their local areas.
[/p][h3][u][b]Overwatch[/b][/u][/h3][p]Peer-to-peer mental health support for veterans and civilians alike, provided through Stack Up’s online community.  

In their 10 years of operation, Stack Up has assisted more than 71,000 veterans. It’s an important mission.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/f9564fe22c554289a342d83950f05e61ea260f4c.png"][/img]
Want to volunteer, or help support their cause?

You can learn more at [url="https://www.stackup.org/"]https://www.stackup.org/[/url]

[h3]Officers, good to see you again. [/h3][p] [/p][p]It’s been a busy couple of weeks in the world of VOID Interactive and Ready or Not as we recently headed to Las Vegas for LVL UP EXPO.  [/p][p] [/p][p]In this community exhibit, you’ll find an overview of what the team got into while in Vegas. Of course, we’ll also be covering the latest and greatest in community made mods, photos, content, and more. [/p][p] [/p][p]Strap in!
 [/p][h1]
[u][i][b]LVL UP Expo[/b][/i][/u] [/h1][p][/p][p]There’s nothing quite like some fun in the desert. [/p][p] [/p][p]As some of you know, over the weekend of April 24-26th , we traveled to Las Vegas, Nevada for LVL UP EXPO. [/p][p] [/p][p]For the unfamiliar, LVL UP EXPO is a fan-centric pop culture and gaming convention hosted at the gargantuan Las Vegas Convention Center! We found out the hard way that it is the US’ biggest convention center when we got dropped off at the wrong building. Great way to get a 20-minute workout in. [/p][p] [/p][p]Before all the fun, glitz, and glamor kicked off, we had to set up![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/2cf9bc1d3bdc5a979498d24b6f51ebcef03c7813.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thankfully we work with some wonderful partners who help us put the booth together and get it ready for attendees.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/0cf33234f351c6461dcc85ff5a63f839cd6f96a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While the booth was under construction, our friends at KWA Airsoft and Full Breach Milsim were getting the SWAT Course Challenge ready and getting their own booth set up. [/p][p] [/p][p]Over the course of the weekend, we had thousands of attendees stop by the booth to say hello. Some people were just hearing about the game for the first time, while others were long-time fans (shout out to all the early supporters who showed up) who were looking to say hello, grab some merch, or just meet the team. [/p][p] [/p][p]We of course had some photo ops for anyone who was interested. As always, our real battering ram and ballistic shield were a huge hit.

[i]Special thanks to our friends at [url="https://www.instagram.com/extremissystems?igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA%3D%3D"]Extremis Systems[/url] for the ballistic shield![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/a91b20a671aa90d7eafeec0108670d43db2c7fed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shoutout to the dogs (and their handlers) who stopped by!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/38a982b4e1d124026c0b09bd042a5df551e80671.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/507151f0685f5856740605617ba224d3f2fe785d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The SWAT Course Challenge was also a huge success! [/p][p] [/p][p]With a line wrapped around our booth throughout the weekend, KWA and Full Breach Milsim did an excellent job at helping us curate a Ready or Not experience that fans, whether new or old, won’t soon forget.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/a786ba605b7c3041f56b604c7b0a44b134e619da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just like in-game, Officers were encouraged to deescalate and use less-lethal tactics to clear the course. The best of the best received an exclusive Ready or Not / KWA patch. If you earned it, we hope you will cherish it![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/69fb602519c2ab3128db1fa2337155da02a1653a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/6040c618f79c06587da578cfd388aaaf85b30b77.jpg"][/img]Our booth also featured plenty of Ready or Not merch for participants to grab. Many of you walked away looking fresh in your new Flight Jackets, while others chose the comfort of a Judge Body Pillow to whisper them to sleep on those cold Vegas nights. Either way, it’s always fun to get more merch into your hands. [/p][p] [/p][p]Missed out on a piece of merch or couldn’t make the show? [/p][p] [/p][p]You can shop our merch collection online![/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/7d01fa0b92f46712026869f11acb83851cb0c369.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/c17d6569e389b5b9a46d509662b27048b34e8593.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/7b66bb2b7fb74a3abfcb87556cd6741db9ce5757.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/c75cde5d2afd001b68eaa7cc68b77dd5e74078f4.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p] [/p][p]US site: [url="https://na.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb"]https://na.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb[/url][/p][p]EU site: [url="https://eu.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb"]https://eu.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb[/url] [/p][p]
Overall, LVL UP EXPO was an awesome experience. There’s nothing like showing up to meet fans and being reminded how incredible our community is, and how quickly it has grown. 
 
We want to extend the kindest thank you to everyone who stopped by, tried out the game, ran through the SWAT Course Challenge, grabbed some merch, took photos, and just generally showed up for us. We appreciate it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/fd4631f9500f15c93b032f4922563c897f7bdc45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, one final thanks to our new friends at KWA Airsoft and Full Breach Milsim for their help in building and running the SWAT Course Challenge. We couldn’t have done it without them![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][u][i][b]Newsletter[/b][/i][/u] [/h1][p]

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b][u][i]Community Creations[/i] [/u][/b][/h1][p]
Mods, art, photography, and even a school project It’s one of our favorite parts about writing these community exhibits — celebrating your work!  [/p][p][/p][h3][b][i][u]Insurgency Asedio [/u][/i][/b][u]by[b][i] ARGPampi[/i][/b][/u][/h3][p]
A departure from Ready or Not’s Los Sueños, this map re-imagines Insurgency’s (a fantastic game) Asedio. For a first-time project, ARGPampi has expanded the original map and created a fun and challenging CQB experience. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="t9POUaI4k1A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

Shattered Remains [/b][/i]by[b][i] StenTheAwesome [/i][/b][i]and[b] Delta1776[/b][/i][/u] [/h3][p] [/p][p]A previous map competition winner, [i]Shattered Nerve [/i]was an incredible addition to the community-created maps on offer. Now included as part of the download, [i]Shattered Remains [/i]pushes the map into the evening, just as a thunderstorm begins to roll in. [/p][p] [/p][p]The atmosphere and level design are top-notch.

Classic blue and yellow let suspects know the feds are on duty. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/520578c6fb474982c8b85899531339759bb9dd5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Download here: [url="https://www.nexusmods.com/readyornot/mods/7777?tab=files"]https://www.nexusmods.com/readyornot/mods/7777?tab=files[/url][/p][p]


[/p][p][b][i][u]MG338 [/u][/i][/b][i][u]by[b] nexGTSI[/b][/u][/i] 
 
Sometimes you just want a bigger gun. The MG338 is that bigger gun. Fair warning, in almost no way, shape, or form, does this follow the standard ROE.

[h1]Attention Officers, [/h1][p] [/p][p]This patch focuses on addressing online authentication connectivity and achievement issues that some players have been experiencing. A huge thank you to everyone who made bug reports, especially on our official [url="https://discord.com/channels/310075021882294272/1050535723087958156"][u]Ready or Not Bug Reports[/u][/url] forum channel, which helped us identify some of the root causes. We are continuing to track and address further bugs for future patches.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Please check our official Discord for an updated list of some known issues in the  [url="https://discord.com/channels/310075021882294272/1394576328073809990"][u]#known-issues-and-fixes channel[/u][/url].  
 [/p][p align="start"][i]We are continuously monitoring your bug reports. Please report any bugs you find in our official Ready or Not Discord, using the bug report channels! There they can be structured and collected in one place so we can most effectively deal with them: [/i][url="https://discord.com/channels/310075021882294272/1050535723087958156"][u]Ready or Not Bug Reports[/u][/url]  
 [/p][h2][b]Patch Day General FAQ:[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Q: ‘My game mods broke on PC with this update, why did that happen?’  [/p][p align="start"]> A: When Ready or Not or games in general release updates to the game, the files for the game in areas related to new game content or fixes then changes. If mods were using the old files to function that have since changed to new files, those mods will likely need to update in order to work properly with the new version of the game’s files. [/p][p align="start"][b]Ready or Not Modding Update Tips:[/b] [url="https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/"]Community Resources[/url]  
 [/p][p]Q: ‘Why does a patch download initially seem frustratingly large in data/gigabytes, even when the game doesn’t actually take up that much more storage when the download finishes’ [/p][p align="start"]> A: Game service platforms such as Steam etc. may update games by overwriting the game's files with the new files to replace it. For example, this means an update download that initially shows 6GB during the download may actually only expand the game by 1GB in size, since it is largely just overwriting old game files for the other 5GB of data.  
 [/p][p]Q: ‘Why does a patch take so long to download despite my fast internet’ [/p][p align="start"]> A: Other routine checks that a game service platform does to confirm game file integrity on the local storage device (e.g. your hard drive such as an HDD or SSD) during a patch download can extend the perceived download size/time.    [/p][p]Q: ‘Why didn’t my game update yet on my console platform?' [/p][p align="start"]> A: Console platforms do not necessarily support auto-updates, so you may have to trigger the update manually within your game library with an internet connection. [/p][p align="start"]  [/p][p align="start"]Thank you for all your support!  [/p][p align="start"][b][i]VOID Interactive[/i][/b]   [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b]   
 [/h1][h2]Multiplayer [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed instances of users being stuck on EOS authentication process. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Achievements [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed “My Eyes, It Burns” achievement not correctly unlocking. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed “Getting Your Sea Legs” sometimes unlocking before unlocking all other Dark Waters achievements. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed “The Heat is On” achievement unlocking even when failing the mission.[/p][/*][/list]

[p]It's about that time, officers. Welcome back.

As you plunge deeper into the woods, it all culminates in an excellent, and dangerous, finale that we don't want to spoil. Bring a shield for this one. Great work all around!

[h1]Attention Officers, [/h1][p][/p][p]Welcome to the 89th edition of our Ready or Not Development Briefing, February 13th, 2026! [/p][p]With elbows deep working on the game before and after this December studio holiday, a period of time adjusting our QA workflows, and introducing a Community Manager here, we’re back for another RoN development briefing with a new game patch on its way shortly. 
 
We are working toward supporting RoN for years to come, in the process of sorting through dozens of new exciting features to slate for future updates and keeping eyes out/working through more bugs to fix. [/p][p]Bugfixes are a top focus for us. Speaking of which, the patch we are releasing in the near future will contain over 200 bugfixes. These include many SWAT AI fixes, suspect fixes, CS gas fixes/improvements (particularly noticeable on Hard Difficulty), and visual fidelity fixes. A release date announcement and further details will arrive in the following weeks.   [/p][p][i]Note: These development briefings serve to keep you in the loop about parts of our ongoing support for Ready or Not. However, the briefings do not encompass everything that we’re working on at a given moment. Please keep in mind that the content in our development briefings may still be a work in progress and subject to change.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u][i][b]Fixes Incoming and Support Going Forward[/b][/i][/u] [/h2][p][/p][p][b]Listed under this section is just a [u][i]small sample of the fixes[/i][/u] that are incoming. The full, much larger changelog will go out when the patch is released for download.[/b] [/p][p]Base game features and content will be coming with this patch too. Among them are the multi-attachment system highlighted in the Vol. 88 dev briefing, improved quality of life for mission and loadout selection in quickplay/multiplayer, and some surprises. [/p][p]We have refined our internal patch structure and triage process to help address bugs with high degrees of player affliction, which will also help deal with legacy bugs. [/p][p]Thank you to those of you who have been using our official Discord’s #bug-report-forum channel, as several of these legacy type bugs are able to be easily corroborated with player reports in there. [/p][p]Certain bugs, such as bugs that cause graphical fidelity issues, were related to our previous build server setup. There were two main types of fidelity bugs: lightmap bugs and level of detail (LOD) bugs. Lightmaps are how light/shadows for static objects are ‘baked’ into the game to enhance the fidelity of textures to give them increased detail, whereas LODs involve multiple stages of model detail often used discretely at different viewing distances as a traditional way to optimize performance in games.  [/p][p]Although we fixed lightmap related issues in previous patches, the remaining issues were largely Level of Detail (LOD) related bugs that were created by multifaceted means when our internal ‘development builds’ were compiled and ‘built’ into ‘shipping builds’ that are released to the public. In some cases lower fidelity LOD models were being used in circumstances where they were not appropriate. We have now moved to an entirely new build server system and are working through remaining LOD issues that have yet to be fixed. [/p][p][u][b]Sample of the fixes in the upcoming patch:[/b][/u] 
(Once again: this section is just a [i][b]small sample of the fixes[/b][/i] that are incoming. The full, much larger changelog will go out when the patch is released for download.) [/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where SWAT AI was not following commands when bumping into each other, the player, other AI, or certain level geometry, after the command was issued. If this happened, SWAT AI would also stop following subsequent commands, assuming the same command was still active. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed SWAT AI sometimes getting stuck when trying to breach and clear a double door that is open towards them. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed SWAT AI sometimes failing to execute open and breach commands, when too many commands are issued in quick succession. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed SWAT disarming bomb vests of civilians resulting in the civilian wearing the bomb vest being unable to surrender. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed third person animation sliding while swapping weapons for SWAT and suspects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed instances where suspects were able to step out of a CS gas cloud before getting affected by the gas. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed suspects/civilians being unable to surrender while getting pepper sprayed. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed suspects at times raising their guns while stunned, making rules of engagement confusing (i.e. while they are influenced by less lethal effects or about to surrender). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed Supporter Edition Code button generating an incorrect code. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p](Steam) Fixed frequent and repeated achievement progression popups. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p](Xbox) Fixed voice chat not working when unplugging and replugging a gamepad mid session. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed frequent crashes when skipping back and forth through a replay’s timeline. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p](Xbox) Fixed LOD issues of various pieces of evidence in the evidence locker. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed SWAT AI being unable to breach and clear one of the tunnel entrances on Twisted Nerve. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed AI sometimes sinking through or getting stuck on one of the staircases on Greased Palms. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed blood particles getting stuck in mid-air in several spots on Valley of the Dolls. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed blood particles getting stuck in mid-air in several spots on Lawmaker. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed SWAT AI officer running off when ordered to clear one of the underground hallways on Carriers of the Vine. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed bullet casings getting stuck in mid-air. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed volumetric lighting breaking when restarting missions while wearing active NVGs. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed beanbag shotgun’s inconsistent recoil return rate. [/p][/*][/list][p][u]Plus:[/u] [/p][list][*][p][i]Many more bugfixes to SWAT AI’s ability to breach and clear rooms or doors across various levels.[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]~200 more fixes[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][u][i][b]Community Manager Welcome[/b][/i][/u] 
[/h2][p]Also helping to facilitate our support for RoN into the future is our new community manager, Austin, aka eyyohbee! He will be helping to maintain ongoing communications with y’all in our public platforms and helping to host any community or creator activities that we may do. 
 [/p][p]We’ll let him formally introduce himself here and we invite you all to join us for a warm welcome! 
[/p][quote][p][i]Hey everyone![/i] [/p][p][i]My name is Austin, aka eyyohbee, and I'm the new community manager at VOID Interactive![/i] [/p][p][i]I'm stoked to be joining the team, and you, on the incredible journey that Ready or Not has been for the last decade. For the past few years, I've watched as the team expanded RoN into one of the grittiest and most immersive tactical shooters in the world. As I watched from the sidelines, playing the game, and diving into the expansive RoN lore, I knew I wanted to be a part of it if I could![/i] [/p][p][i]I'm thankful for the opportunity and looking forward to working with both the team and the community to continue building RoN into the defining tactical shooter of our generation![/i][/p][/quote][p] [/p][h1]Conclusion [/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you all for attending this briefing, and we’ll see you in the upcoming videos and posts leading up to the next patch and in the years more to come! Keep an eye out for our CM eyyohbee and please join us in giving him a warm welcome![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90eea2aeb7449fef24bf55b66fe1bc4c923c6b69.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Follow Ready or Not on Steam[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/"][u] here[/u][/url].[/b]

newsitems.title: Community Exhibit Vol. 22 - Ready or Not's Second Anniversary
newsitems.author: chris.riccetto
newsitems.contents: [h3]Tune in, officers![/h3][p]It's been two years since Ready or Not went into its full 1.0 release. A lot has changed for the LSPD over the years. The community has grown exponentially, but crime continues to hit Los Sueños. [/p][p][/p][p]In the near future, we look forward to sharing more about what's coming with Ready or Not in 2026, especially with regards to future patches and the upcoming DLC that is planned for next year. For the moment, we'll focus on reflecting back. Thank you to everyone that showed up and thank you to everyone that continues to play Ready or Not. [/p][p][/p][p]To give a clear idea of just how much your service has gone towards supporting citizens of Los Sueños, we have the stats to back it up. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Ready or Not's 2nd Anniversary Since 1.0 Release[/h2][p]After completing 112 million missions across the Los Sueños area, the performance of D Platoon team has averaged with a C-rank. That does leave room for improvement, yet realistically not every mission can be S-Rank even under the best of situations and the best of intel. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/a3f7f4cb786086f9cd9ead0b1121748f319a8514.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]LSPD SWAT COMMUNITY NUMBERS[/h2][p]Of those 112M completed missions, the relative difficulty has varied widely for each team. One in five officers prefers responding to situations of lower volatility. Meanwhile nearly 10% of active LSPD SWAT have opted to take on the most dynamic situations. No matter where you land on preferences, your services are to be commended for taking the step towards ensuring the safety and security of your fellow citizens and bringing order to chaos. [/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/a44d50d4ed6d4ef7755282e598ddd2729275be1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In fact, from those who are the most vulnerable and need your help, nearly 9 out of 10 civilians across every completed mission have been accounted for and brought out of harm's way. Of the suspects who could not be talked down and persisted in endangering life, nearly 3 out of 4 succumbs to lethal force of our LSPD SWAT officers. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/0b0d740e3bab227c7cd81ec5999ff4889c3b33c2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As we look back on previous mission calls, here are the areas where our LSPD officers are most often deployed across Los Sueños: The San Uriel Condominiums, 4U Gas Stations in South Los Sueños, the postal facility in East Los Sueños, the Clemente Hotel district in Downtown Los Sueños, and a private residence in Los Clemente.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/25db199417ce25fc87e11d8f8b4a6e9e34c3c9dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/3b0b992e9a66f7310e5adcc8f772cfbe8cb84778.jpg"][/img]It's lonely to go it alone, take command.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Weight Of The Badge Collection[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/88dec6d4b959768b73ef58e18e31fd2519bf5452.jpg"][/img]In celebration of our second-year anniversary, we've been working on a limited edition 'Weight Of The Badge' Collection featuring several items that are truly exclusive and only available in this collection including the Entry Team Breaching Statue, Collector's Edition 2-LP Vinyl, MLO patch, and the Ready or Not Artbook.[/p][p][/p][p]The Weight of the Badge Collection is available for purchase now. Delivery will occur in batches as the orders are received between now and through the end of February. Check out the collection here:[/p][p]US site:       [url="https://na.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb"]https://na.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb[/url][/p][p]EU site:       [url="https://eu.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb"]https://eu.merch.voidinteractive.net/wotb[/url][/p][p]Unboxing video: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/GRzxGcrwwh4"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Down The Rabbit Hole - Episode 6[/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="RwvmVAKJrT4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The latest on lore from [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ShayneNoOneCares"]Shayne[/url] and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@TheIssacMorgan"]Issac [/url]is back with Lore Episode 6. In this concluding chapter on the USIA, Shayne and Issac are talking about everything around the connection between the USIA and the MLO and bring to the forefront all the known conspiracies for each of these groups.[/p][p][/p][h2]User Generated Content[/h2][p]Fan creations are a very special part of our community, and below are a few of our favorites from the years. There’s also a new arrival in the form of a group of LSPD cosplayers with a custom ballistic shield prop! We made sure they got some LSPD Officer badges to go with their kits. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/5186737e7387537b7bf347113c5685041e604341.jpg"][/img]Look no evil, speak no evil. Credit to Blackbird[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/998dfd7e28a7699d72300015d1cea53893e6cdf5.jpg"][/img]Officer Down. Credit to Born_Wild[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/26e4a2a2f24eb172bcc04c71448838be62876da3.jpg"][/img]A tight knit team of LSPD SWAT Cosplayers: @nona.cosplay, @Macka1tack, and @Karaxian.cosplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//36750080/de3f0b12afb03a4f3e2b56073b833e074e393bbf.jpg"][/img]A good boy, the best of boys. Credit to CraziestBoi.[/p][p][/p][p]As we close out 2025, and our second year of Ready or Not in full release, we're forever grateful to our community who've been with us since the beginning and the new recruits that are making Ready or Not the quintessential tactical shooter. At the close of this year, we are now at nearly 14 million SWAT officers across our PC and console platforms. [/p][p][/p][p]Going forward, we can’t wait to share more on what is coming for Ready or Not, see what the community brings to the table as we update the game, until then [b]stack up and clear out[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][i]VOID Interactive[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow Ready or Not on Steam[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/"][u] here[/u][/url].[/b]  [/p][p][b]Our other links:[url="https://discord.gg/readyornot"][u] Discord[/u][/url],[url="https://twitter.com/voidinteractive"][u] X[/u][/url],[url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj3qNoOLkzHJ60vxG6xQvlA"][u] YouTube[/u][/url],[url="https://www.instagram.com/void_interactive/"][u] Instagram[/u][/url],[url="https://www.facebook.com/VOIDInteractive/"][u] Facebook[/u][/url], [url="https://open.spotify.com/artist/45BAMXfGgTZxfbf6GpKwX7?si=sdHNYMFxRYeLAZp6yr0ryQ"][u]Spotify.[/u][/url][/b] [/p]

newsitems.title: Ready or Not Development Briefing - Vol. 88
newsitems.author: catindabox
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Attention Officers,[/h1][p][/p][p]Welcome to the 88th Ready or Not Development Briefing, Oct 31st, 2025! [/p][p]Happy Halloween officers, whether you’ll be suited up for a mission tonight or trick or treating.  [/p][p]In this briefing, we’ll be outlining a shift in our Quality Assurance department, with new onboarding and expansion of the team working toward more fixes for the game. [/p][p]There’s also some new details to show about the current state of our multi-attachment rail system, and an explanation for dev briefing schedules going forward on a by-announcement basis.  [/p][p][i]Note: These development briefings serve to keep you in the loop about parts of our ongoing support for Ready or Not, however the briefings do not encompass everything that we’re working on at a given moment. Please keep in mind that the content in our development briefings may still be a work in progress and subject to change[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][u][i][b]Internal QA Onboarding and Expansion[/b][/i][/u] [/h2][p][/p][p]This autumn we began the process of shifting and expanding our existing internal Quality Assurance department and teams to aid in providing future game fixes.  [/p][p]The first step is the onboarding of new QA members who will continue to help our other departments fix bugs and verify new features are functioning appropriately. [/p][p]This is an intensive hand-off period involved with QA teams and other departments as their work is intimately tied to in-depth understanding of game documentation and systems.  [/p][p]Part of the learning process of launching on multiple platforms is that we have requirements to test multiple consoles and storefronts. There are now specific certification quality requirements and verification timelines alongside general testing across systems for unique issues that could pop up.  [/p][p]Therefore, QA testing for us is now twofold: functional testing (ensuring features are working and verifying bugs to be fixed) and certification testing (ensuring we meet quality requirements for each individual platform or system). [/p][p]Expanding this QA department, especially adding a dedicated certification-specific QA team that allows our functional QA testing team to continue testing new features or bugs simultaneously, is central to our game update strategy going forward. [/p][p] [/p][h2][u][i][b]Multi-attachment Rail System[/b][/i][/u] [/h2][p][/p][p]One of the upcoming major features that we can show right now is the multi-attachment rail system for a future update. [/p][p]At its most basic level, this system will allow you to equip and operate multiple barrel attachments at once, i.e. a red laser and flashlight together.[/p][p]The barrel multi-attachment feature went through some other slight expansion since we last mentioned it. You can look forward to some extra quality of life improvements and amenities than were planned before, and it now serves as a framework for long-term scalability on weapon platform features. [/p][p]Some attachments such as the PEQ-15 are multi-functional, with the PEQ-15 having the option to swap between visible laser and IR laser as an all-in-one package.  [/p][p][u](Images: Screenshots of various weapons with red laser and flashlight simultaneously[/u] [u]equipped)[/u] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/02d5327985c234ca962bf8038a83ad0ed3a2a421.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/5d3a5fead1bdf68a9c57fd3f1f135d10dba1d663.png"][/img][/p][p][i][u](Image below: PEQ-15 on a MK17 activating a red laser instead of what was previously only its IR laser)[/u][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/041e8eeeb3a152010c6d01d72b8b74db7ad75b21.png"][/img][/p][p]A new miscellaneous attachment slot allows for canted iron sights to be mounted onto weapons for precision target acquisition in canted mode.

Meanwhile our Low Power Variable Optics (LPVOs) such as the ATAK-R 1-12x have the updated ability to switch between different magnification levels. Or go compact with a new red dot sight with 3x magnifier option. [/p][p][i][u](Image below: Looking down the new canted ironsight can provide better accuracy and muzzle manueverability in tight spaces)[/u][/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/c4719103455cc4df8e589ba8dbc512dca9683913.png"][/img][/p][p][u](Image below: New red dot 3x magnification combo. Take away a bit of your horizontal line of sight for some emergency magnification)[/u] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/8460a244c06daede614f3399f7c3c8873e69a441.png"][/img][/p][p]Certain weapons like the MP9 SMG have low rail space, so it’s worth considering how visually bulky you want your weapon profile to be as well as what space you have when deciding on these sorts of attachments [/p][p]As a bonus, players may choose to add carry handles to select weapons which typically support them, such as the G36C and currently MK18 for the AR side. On the G36C the carry handle offers additional rail space for larger optics at the sacrifice of extra height-over-bore. Both MK18 and G36C customizations offer an iconic profile.[/p][p][u](Image below: G36C w/ carry handle optic and multiple barrel attachments)[/u] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/52978e456893bd604d602b9ebdba8e5e8256d668.png"][/img][/p][p][u](Image slideshow below: MK18 w/ carry handle and G36C option without carry handle)[/u] [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/5efd7bce0721b574d43cdd9cd13ab51645aec3ca.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/e13fcabc2160277b9e1f35066713ae5697df68cc.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][u][i][b]Dev Briefing by-announcement Schedule[/b][/i][/u] [/h2][p][/p][p]These development briefings are now going to be on a by-announcement basis rather than a fixed schedule. This means sometimes it will take longer between briefs than our previous 4-week schedule and that sometimes we might make dev brief posts on a quicker schedule if necessary. [/p][p]There are a couple reasons for this new schedule: [/p][p]The first reason is that we want to continue to prioritize the ability to give you dev briefs when they're ready. [/p][p]Secondly, we recognize that since we’re well past 1.0 launch, there are fewer simultaneous major system changes across the game that can regularly be shown off and alternated between.  [/p][p]This way there is an expectation of more flexibility on our team for when they might drop, with the added benefit of maintaining quality per dev briefing. [/p][p][/p][h1]Conclusion [/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for sticking with us as we continue to work towards more fixes for the game. The upcoming flexibility that our multi-attachment system will offer meanwhile will help you best configure and utilize loadouts for each mission. We’ll see you in the next briefing. [/p][p]One last thing, our next line of merch is rolling out including patches, pins, mouse pads, and desk mats-- with more to come. 

[u](Image below: Mousepads and more rolling out to our [/u][url="https://na.merch.voidinteractive.net/?srsltid=AfmBOoo5loESX7_qdH37hwvl37DPBH_IiiM9USykbLy6zjQlBR6zFZi3"]merch store page[/url][u])[/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/618fc7acc602f628b455974bb9d774ddbaf9e9cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]
[/b][i]This concludes our 88th development briefing, thank you for joining us. Be sure to fall in next time for more development news![/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90eea2aeb7449fef24bf55b66fe1bc4c923c6b69.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Follow Ready or Not on Steam[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/"][u] here[/u][/url].[/b]
